source_scope: backend/frontend .py/.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.css/.html including tests and source-like config; dependencies/builds/coverage/caches/docs excluded
source_attribution_scope: own inherited Tessl Stage 1 plus Gemini-generated app/test changes; researcher helpers/evidence excluded; text counts alone do not prove authorship
spec_scope: original Tessl specs/requirements.md and specs/session_notes.md separately from new specs/stage2 Markdown/JSON; no other tool feature content
text_counting_rules: UTF-8 BOM removal and LF normalization; physical lines use splitlines; original byte hashes retained; line deltas compare logical lines; net characters are state-size differences, not cumulative edit volume
density_definition: physical lines / files, rounded to two decimals; not a quality or scalability score
snapshot_scope: only closed *.run.json intervals contribute usage/time/attempt totals; open metadata separate; source/spec counts reflect collection time

source_change.character_delta_definition: net change in total decoded Unicode text length, after BOM removal and LF normalization; not cumulative edit volume or an added/removed-character operation count

spec_stage1_copy_change.character_delta_definition: net change in total decoded Unicode text length, after BOM removal and LF normalization; not cumulative edit volume or an added/removed-character operation count

spec_stage2_change_from_empty.character_delta_definition: net change in total decoded Unicode text length, after BOM removal and LF normalization; not cumulative edit volume or an added/removed-character operation count

stage2_spec_delta_scope: new specs/stage2 measured against empty directory; original inherited native docs measured separately

dependency_manifests_change.character_delta_definition: net change in total decoded Unicode text length, after BOM removal and LF normalization; not cumulative edit volume or an added/removed-character operation count

stage2_identifier_scope: unique identifier-pattern candidates in Stage 2 requirements.md; not independently adjudicated atomic-requirement or acceptance counts

runs.label: 01-specify
runs.workflow: Gemini CLI with Tessl MCP and vendored plugin context
runs.submission_method: complete multiline plain prompt via direct Node entrypoint

disable_evidence.method: Read-only embedded JavaScript inspection of the exact SHA-pinned executable
disable_evidence.interpretation: Interval zero disables automatic binary replacement, rather than checking on every invocation. TESSL_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 additionally disables update actions. This does not assert that telemetry or latest-version lookup is disabled.

tessl_runtime.rationale: Direct versioned executable matches the final installed Stage 1 Tessl runtime; NPM bootstrap version is recorded separately and is not executed.

classification.reason: Gemini-authored Stage 2 atomic requirements and checklist using Tessl MCP/plugin context; not a native Tessl generator. No app/test edits authorized in this phase.
classification.outcome_definition: closed means the invocation ended, including failure/interruption; exit-zero means process success only, not independently verified correction/acceptance success

cli_tool_actions.scope: tool execution statistics inside one external invocation; includes reads and other actions, not just code changes or Sonar scans; never counted as additional external correction prompts. A successful tool wrapper does not establish a shell command/test pass; inspect raw exit codes and logs.

integration_observations.coverage: actual recorded call IDs inside the closed run interval, deduplicated across original/archive snapshots
integration_observations.limitation: A call name or successful wrapper alone does not prove plugin activation, wrapped command success or useful returned context. Raw retained outputs are authoritative; unavailable/unrecorded calls are not inferred failures.

tokens.api_scope: all models and roles present in completed CLI statistics; requests include failed attempts
tokens.transcript_coverage: observed token-bearing JSONL responses deduplicated by response ID; does not count failed API attempts or unrecorded auxiliary calls

correction_counts.classification_version: researcher-reviewed v2; external attempts, distinct QA intents, retries and process outcomes are separate
correction_counts.scope: External correction attempts are separate from initial implementation, preimplementation spec clarification, launcher retries, and automated within-session edits/scans. A retry can share one QA intent. Closed includes failed attempts; exit-zero does not establish functional acceptance. Started counts include open metadata. Unknown future labels remain unclassified until reviewed.

prompt_count_note: compatibility alias for closed launcher attempts, including proven pre-model failures; not actual model prompts
duration_scope: known instrumented CLI invocation duration, including failed attempts; unknown durations and all external researcher work excluded
token_scope: completed CLI stats include all reported model/roles; JSONL fallback only observed responses. Input means prompt including cache; candidates/thoughts separate; unknowns not imputed
usage_provenance_limit: Gemini CLI experiment including reported auxiliary roles only; excludes Codex/researcher orchestration, reviews, helper authoring, setup, Drive/UI and independent verification. Not total project tokens/cost
api_totals_scope: known completed CLI counters and proven pre-model zeroes; unknown intervals excluded
recorded_response_scope: token-bearing JSONL response IDs deduplicated across originals/archives and bounded by each run interval; distinct from API attempts and may omit auxiliary responses
researcher_setup_scope: environment setup/replication and its failures are not Gemini model invocation attempts or token usage
integration_scope: actual Tessl MCP/plugin context workflow; no native Tessl spec/build generator command is claimed
